title: 65_HS1-834228961_62-HQ-83894_Serial_438
doc_notes: This is an FBI case file regarding the Socorro, New Mexico, UFO incident of April 24, 1964, containing detailed firsthand accounts from Officer Lonnie Zamora and physical site observations.

encounters.summary: Officer Lonnie Zamora observed a shiny, oval-shaped object on the ground near Socorro, NM, accompanied by two individuals in white coveralls. The object rose with a loud roar and flame, leaving physical traces in the ground and burning brush.
encounters.entity_appearance: two individuals in white coveralls, normal shape, small adults or large kids
physical_effects: three smooth circular marks in sand
encounters.quote: unknown object which landed and has taken off
